user.title: Add a Host
user.description: Enter the address of a Host that has the Hostbeacon Agent installed.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Host.
data_description.port: The Agent's port. Change it only if the Host owner changed it.

pair.title: Pair with {host}
pair.description: On the Host, run `sudo hostbeacon pair`. Enter the Pairing code it shows.

data_description.code: 12 characters, for example K7QM-4XPT-9RWD. It works once, for 10 minutes.

reconfigure.title: Change the address of {host}
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address of the Host. Home Assistant accepts it only if the Agent there has the same certificate as before.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Host.
data_description.port: The Agent's port. Change it only if the Host owner changed it.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair {host}
reauth_confirm.description:
Re-pair only if {host} was reinstalled, or its key or certificate was replaced. The Host keeps its entities, names, areas, automations, and history.

On the Host, run `sudo hostbeacon pair`. Enter the Host's address and the Pairing code it shows.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Host.
data_description.port: The Agent's port. Change it only if the Host owner changed it.
data_description.code: 12 characters, for example K7QM-4XPT-9RWD. It works once, for 10 minutes.

reauth_same_host.title: Is this the same Host?
reauth_same_host.description:
The Agent at {address} says its hostname is **{hostname}**.

Is this the same machine as {host}? If yes, select Submit. If not, close this dialog; nothing was changed.

reauth_copy.title: Is this the same Host?
reauth_copy.description:
The Agent at {address} says its hostname is **{hostname}**.

**Warning: this machine is a copy of another Host.** Its Agent found that it was copied (for example, a cloned VM). If you Re-pair it as {host}, the original machine can no longer be shown as {host}.

Continue only if this is the same machine as {host}.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Agent at this address. Check the address and the port, and that the Agent is running.
error.invalid_code: The Pairing code is wrong, expired, or already used. Make a new code on the Host and try again.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed: the Agent did not prove that it knows the code. Check that this is the address of the right Host.
error.other_host: This Agent belongs to another Host in Home Assistant. Check the address, or remove the other Host first.
error.same_machine_required: Tick "It is the same machine" to go on, or close this dialog.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.invalid_discovery_info: This announcement is not from a Hostbeacon Agent.
abort.reauth_successful: The Host was Re-paired. It keeps its entities and history.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot log in to the Agent with the new Pairing. Nothing was changed. Make a new Pairing code on the Host and try again.

pairing_not_removed_title.message: Host removed, but its Pairing is still on the Host

pairing_not_removed.message:
Home Assistant could not reach {host} to remove its Pairing, so the Host still accepts this Home Assistant's key. On the Host, run:

`sudo hostbeacon pairings remove {pairing_id}`

reboot_not_admin.message: Only Home Assistant admins can reboot {host}.

reboot_disabled.message: Reboot is turned off on {host}. The Host owner can turn it on in the Agent config.

reboot_too_soon_after_boot.message: {host} started less than 10 minutes ago. Reboot is possible after {time}.

action_busy.message: {host} is busy with a package task. Try again later.

action_update_run_running.message: An Update run is already running on {host}.

action_cannot_log.message: {host} refused: the Agent cannot write its Action log.

action_duplicate.message: This {action} was already sent to {host}. Waiting for its result.

action_duplicate_ok.message: This {action} was already sent to {host}. Its result: OK.

action_duplicate_failed.message: This {action} was already sent to {host}. Its result: failed ({error}).

action_no_answer.message: {host} did not answer the {action} request. Check that it is Online and try again.

update_run_not_admin.message: Only Home Assistant admins can update {host}.

update_run_disabled.message: Update run is turned off on {host}. The Host owner can turn it on in the Agent config.

update_run_needs_manual_update.message: {host} needs a manual update: the Update run would remove packages or change the distro release, so it installed nothing. See the release notes of Updates.

update_run_result_unknown.message: The result of the Update run on {host} is unknown: the connection ended before the run did. Home Assistant shows the result when {host} reports again.

release_notes_not_supported.message: Available updates are not supported on {host}.

release_notes_unknown.message: The Host cannot read its Available updates right now.

release_notes_last_run_waiting_for_lock.message: **Update run:** Waiting for the package manager

release_notes_last_run_needs_manual_upda.message: **Last Update run:** Needs manual update, {age} ago

release_notes_list_never.message: **Package list refreshed:** Not yet by Hostbeacon

release_notes_update_run_off.message: Update run is turned off on {host}, so Install is not offered. The Host owner can turn it on in the Agent config.

confirm.title: Certificate of {host} changed
confirm.description:
The Agent at the address of {host} shows a different certificate, so Home Assistant refuses to connect to it. {host} is Offline.

Re-pair only if the Host was reinstalled, or its key was replaced with `hostbeacon regenerate-key`. Otherwise another machine may be at this address: check the address first.

Select Submit to start Re-pair.

abort.repair_started: Re-pair of {host} started. In Settings > Repairs, select "Authentication expired for {host}" to continue.
abort.host_removed: This Host is no longer in Home Assistant.

two_machines.title: Two machines share the identity of {host}
two_machines.description:
Two machines answered as {host} at the same time. One of them is probably a copy (for example, a cloned VM) that the Agent did not detect. Home Assistant stays connected to the saved address.

On the copy, run `sudo hostbeacon reset-identity`, then add it as a new Host.

update_run_long.title: Update run on {host} is taking over 1 hour
update_run_long.description:
The Update run on {host} started more than 1 hour ago and is still running. Hostbeacon never stops an Update run.

To see what it is doing, run on the Host:

`journalctl -u hostbeacon-update-run`

This repair goes away when the run ends.

package_system_broken.title: Package system on {host} is broken
package_system_broken.description:
The package system on {host} reports a problem, so updates may fail. Run this command on the Host to fix it, or to see what is wrong:

`{command}`

This repair goes away when {host} reports that the package system works again.

needs_manual_update.title: {host} needs a manual update
needs_manual_update.description:
The last Update run on {host} installed nothing, because it would remove packages or move the Host to another distro release. Hostbeacon never does either by itself.

The release notes of the {host} Updates entity list the packages. Update the Host by hand, and check what the package manager would change before you accept: `sudo apt full-upgrade` (Debian, Ubuntu) or `sudo dnf upgrade` (Fedora, RHEL).

This repair goes away when a later Update run passes its checks, or no Available updates are left.
